title: Validate a domain decomposition — validate_decomposition
text: Structural checks, run order: Outlet count — basin's domain_connectivity overlay resolves exactly one outlet sub-network via sort_network() split = TRUE. Domains may multiple outlets design checked. Coverage / partition — every source_network id appears exactly one domain's catchments slot. Connectivity membership — domain's rows carry reserved outlet toid value (genuine basin outlets, whose source_network toid carries reserved value) appear, toids intact, basin's domain_connectivity overlay. See hy_domain() dual-ownership rule behind duplication. Inter-domain cycle — derived domain graph (get_domain_graph() relations = "flow") acyclic; checked delegating check_hy_graph(). Nexus existence — every nexus_id referenced flow row derived inter-domain edge list registered nexus_registry. Containment relationships checked flow crosses hydro nexus contained containing domains. Containment resolution — every non-NA containing_domain_id resolves key decomposition$domains, domain contained , sequence containers (inside B inside C, ...) loop back . acyclic check runs check_hy_graph() containment relationships pulled domain. Override references — every row overrides (present) names known source/sink domain via id/toid known source/sink nexus via source_nexus_id/sink_nexus_id.
